coffee-fund-a-0-sterling.text: The coffee fund is voluntary, Milo. Whoever drinks it, pays for it. That is the entire system.

coffee-fund-a-1-milo.text: Voluntary? You bought the machine, and you set the price. That's not a market, that's a landlord.

coffee-fund-b-0-milo.text: Pool it. Everyone pays four euros, everyone drinks, nobody counts cups.

coffee-fund-b-1-sterling.text: And by Thursday the pot is empty, and nobody knows whose fault that is.

committee-a-0-alli.text: The policy is neutral. Same rules, same forms, same panel for everyone. That is fairness.

committee-a-1-valentino.text: Darling, neutral rules on an unequal floor just make the tilt official.

committee-b-0-omar.text: Mm. You are both arguing about the ladder. I am asking who built the wall.

committee-b-1-valentino.text: Finally. Someone in this room with an actual question.

loft-a-0-grant.text: Nobody works harder because a committee asked them to. They work harder because it's theirs.

loft-a-1-jax.text: Or because the rent is due. Let's not dress that up as ambition.

loft-a-2-barney.text: Ohhh, I love it when the bird gets bleak.

loft-b-1-milo.text: They started without you because you'd have made it about the coffee fund.
